title: In JetBrains TeamCity before 2026.1.3, 2025.11.7 remote code execution was possible via build attribute injection…
description: A critical remote code execution vulnerability exists in JetBrains TeamCity versions before 2026.1.3 and 2025.11.7. The flaw involves build attribute injection, which could allow an attacker with limited privileges to execute arbitrary code remotely. The vulnerability is identified as CVE-2026-132233 and has a CVSS score of 9.9, indicating a severe impact on confidentiality, integrity, and availability.
